narrative.headline: Energy dominates today's smart money flow with concentrated bullish positioning across both E&P and Refining subsectors of XLE.
bullish_themes: Broad XLE conviction: 9 of 10 drilldown names are Energy, spanning both E&P (FANG, EXE, DVN, OXY, COP, APA) and Refining (PSX, PBF, MPC) — this is a coordinated sector bid, not a single-name story
Refining subgroup shows split personality: PSX and PBF drawing aggressive bullish flow while VLO sees 84% bearish premium — pair-trade or relative-value positioning likely in play
Diagnostics & Research is bifurcated: DGX is the lone bullish name while DHR, A, and NTRA all show bearish flow — smart money is picking winners, not buying the industry
notable_individual_flows: EXE: $800K premium with 19 ask-side bullish prints — highest conviction footprint in the scan
DVN: $1.03M premium with 12 ask-side bullish prints — largest E&P bullish notional
PSX: perfect 1.0 bullish ratio with 5 ask-side prints — cleanest refining signal
NTRA: $2.69M premium at 71% bearish — largest bearish tell in the dataset, worth flagging as a short candidate
EQT: $1.09M premium at 71% bearish despite sitting in the otherwise-bullish E&P group — the one E&P name smart money is fading
narrative.absences: No bullish flow in Tech, Financials, Consumer, or Industrials despite the broader Industry Layer scanning 30 candidates. Diagnostics & Research qualified as an industry but flow contradicts the setup on 3 of 4 names.
